hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: On each buy (ETH→token), takes a 1.2% ETH fee accumulated for periodic buyback-and-burn; on each sell (token→ETH), takes a 1.2% token fee and queues it for burning. Blocks exact-output swaps and sells in the same block as a buyback. Limits the pool to a single initial liquidity deposit and can restrict sells to a deployer-managed allowlist via the permissionless `superTokens()` function.
